name: D18 Phase 2 and D28 Phase 1 conductor-supported platforms, Sarawak
description: D18 Phase 2 installed in 35 m water depth for OceanMight on behalf of PETRONAS Carigali; lightweight conductor-supported substructure and topside installed by jack-up drilling rig; eighth conductor-supported platform installed in Malaysian waters by 2H Kuala Lumpur office.
